title: Head De Vendas | Regionais
description:
Descrição da vaga



O Estadã o é uma das maiores e mais influentes empresas de informação e comunicação do Brasil. Acreditamos no poder da informação como ferramenta de transformação social, capacitando e preparando as pessoas para os desafios do futuro.



Se você é um profissional flexível, lida bem com mudanças, tem foco em resultados e adora propor novas ideias, aqui é o seu lugar!


Sua missão será gerir as operações de vendas region ais em território nacional, liderando equipes de alta performance para garantir o cumprimento de me tas, o fortalecimento da cultura comerc ial e a execução de estratégias que envolvam a gestão de pess oas, a interface institucional e a expansão de merc ado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar e desenvolver times regionais e representantes comerciais, assegurando alto desempenho, engajamento e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Monitorar e analisar metas, indicadores de performance e a evolução das carteiras comerciais em todo o território nacional.
  • Promover a integração e a colaboração entre as regionais, estimulando a troca de boas práticas e sinergias.
  • Representar a empresa institucionalmente em fóruns, eventos e encontros setoriais, mantendo forte relacionamento com clientes locais, órgãos públicos e entidades relevantes.
  • Assegurar a execução rigorosa das estratégias comerciais e de relacionamento, fortalecendo parcerias estratégicas.
  • Conduzir reuniões de gestão e apoiar as equipes na construção de soluções personalizadas e sustentáveis para os clientes.
  • Garantir a consistência e a padronização dos processos de gestão de vendas (forecast, CRM e rituais de acompanhamento).
  • Realizar viagens frequentes (2 a 3 vezes/mês) para acompanhamento das regionais e reuniões presenciais com clientes estratégicos.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão comercial B2B (Business-to-Business), com atuação em escopo regional ou nacional.
  • Residir preferencialmente em São Paulo (capital), ou nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro ou Brasília.
  • Experiência prévia comprovada em empresas do setor de mídia e comunicação.
  • Expertise em venda de projetos de mídia multiplataforma (impresso, digital, rádio, branded content e eventos).
  • Histórico sólido em liderança de equipes e representantes comerciais.
  • Capacidade comprovada de transitar entre diferentes níveis hierárquicos, da operação ao board .
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, influência e negociação.
  • Perfil de liderança inspirador, colaborativo e fortemente orientado a resultados.
  • Demonstrar visão estratégica, organização e boa gestão de pressão e prazos.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pela empresa.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Experiência em gestão matricial ou em estrutura nacional de equipes comerciais.
  • Vivência em relações institucionais e parcerias público-privadas (PPP).
  • Fluência em Inglês e/ou Espanhol para interface com parceiros globais.
  • Domínio de sistemas CRM (Customer Relationship Management) e gestão de pipeline comercial.
  • Experiência em projetos de Marketing de Influência.



Informações adicionais


  • Assistência médica e odontológica;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Casual every day;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Restaurante Interno;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Acesso ao conteúdo digital completo do Estadão;
  • Descontos exclusivos em instituições de ensino;
  • Auxílio Psicológico - Vittude.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass);

title: Quality Control Analyst
description:
Working at Ruhrpumpen means being part of a team that values innovation, dynamism, and creativity. Join our team, experience making a difference and build your career!


As Quality Control Analyst you will guarantee and assure that company’s products (hydraulic components and systems) and the materials used in manufacturing them meet the required standards, ensuring the highest levels of quality for customers.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Interpret test results, compare them to established specifications and control limits, and make recommendations on the appropriateness of data for release.
  • Conduct thorough inspections and tests on raw materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure they meet predefined quality standards and specifications.
  • Collect and document data from quality tests, inspections, and audits, and maintain accurate records of quality control processes.
  • Perform visual inspections of finished products and provide assistance to production staff in terms of quality control procedures.
  • Identify and analyze any defects, discrepancies, or non-conformities in the finished products or processes, and collaborate with relevant teams to amend these issues.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to management and relevant stakeholders on the results of quality control tests.
  • Provide guidance to production and quality control staff on quality standards, testing procedures, and best practices to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the organization.
  • Lead the creation of quality documents within scope of customer projects (Industrial Pumps and Auxiliary Systems).
  • Lead plant's ISO audits and Customer Quality audits with support from corporate's quality team.
  • Unroll company´s global Quality Managment System into Ruhrpumpen Jundiai plant.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor´s degree in Engineering areas (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil)
  • Experience in Quality Assurance and/or Quality Control for Industrial plants in Brazil
  • Languages: Conversational English is a must, Spanish proficiency is desirable.
  • IT systems: Office Package & CAD viewing (drawings interpretation) necessary, PowerBI tools are desirable.

title: Analista De Processos – Pleno
description:
Analista de Processos Pleno

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria tecnológica e operacional que aumentem a eficiência dos processos internos. Seu papel envolve mapear fluxos, propor soluções técnicas e acompanhar a efetividade das implementações, garantindo que as mudanças tragam ganhos reais e sustentáveis para a operação.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Identificar, por meio de métodos Lean e análise de processos, oportunidades de melhoria e automação;
  • Mapear o processo AS IS e propor o TO BE, apoiando o refinamento das estórias em parceria com o Analista Funcional;
  • Revisar procedimentos e políticas, elaborando e aplicando treinamentos para as equipes envolvidas nas mudanças;
  • Atuar na gestãode mudanças, garantindo que a operação se adapte às novas soluções sem impactos negativos;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia das soluções implementadas por meio de análises quantitativas e qualitativas, propondo ajustes quando necessário;
  • Promover alinhamento entre as áreas de tecnologia e negócio para garantir que as melhorias estejam em conformidade com as metas estratégicas da companhia.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com melhoria de processos, eficiência operacional ou gestão da mudança em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias Lean e ferramentas de análise de processos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir oportunidades de negócio em soluções técnicas ou operacionais viáveis;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe habilidade de conduzir treinamentos e alinhamentos entre áreas;
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a resultados e atento a detalhes.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência em transformação digital ou implantação de soluções tecnológicas;
  • Dominar ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Excel avançado, etc.) para acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
  • Já tiver atuadoem empresas de grande porte ou em projetos de melhoria contínua de alta complexidade;
  • Possuir certificações ou formações complementares em Lean Six Sigma, Gestão de Processos (BPM) ou Gestão da Mudança (ADKAR, PROSCI);
  • Demonstrar iniciativa e capacidade de facilitar a colaboração entre times técnicos e operacionais.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo



Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Writer & Researcher
description:
About Leaders League Brasil :

Leaders League Brasil was established in 2015 and today covers the country’s legal and financial markets via more than 100 rankings and daily news stories. We enjoy a fully international working environment and use English on a daily basis to communicate with colleagues and partners outside of Brazil. Currently, the Brazil team consists of three major divisions: Research & Editorial, Commercial and Events . We are based in Pinheiros, enjoy a great working environment and frequently organize social outings together.

Research & Editorial - Vacancies :

Leaders League Brasil is currently seeking a Writer & Researcher to work from our São Paulo office. The vacancy on offer is part of the Research & Editorial division. Being a part of our Research & Editorial team provides professionals with the opportunity to (i) publish digital and print news articles on Brazil’s legal and financial markets;
(ii) attend high-profile industry events;
(iii) and interview senior legal and financial professionals. Recent interviewees Katia Vaskys (General Manager - IBM Brasil), Ana Pellegrini (General Counsel - QuintoAndar) and Patricia Vanzolini (President - OAB-SP)

About the Role :

1. Research : You will frequently interview senior players within Brazil’s legal and financial markets, evaluate research documents containing highly confidential information and summarize your findings in concise but informative decisions. We often work with tight deadlines, as such, organization and a hard-working attitude are essential.

2. Writing : On a weekly basis, you will draft short articles, in English and Portuguese, about the latest legal and financial news taking place in Brazil. Additionally, you will author longer news articles and have the opportunity to interview high-profile Brazilian figures in the legal and financial spheres.

3. Publishing : Members of the Research & Editorial team are heavily involved in all aspects of publishing our work. This includes tasks such as writing, editing, proofreading, proactively double-checking information, uploading content to our website and more. A strong attention to detail is paramount to this role.

4. Travel : The opportunity to travel nationally and internationally and to progress swiftly within the company exists for the right candidate. Recent events have taken our senior team members to South Korea, United States, France, Mexico, Colombia as well as to Brazilian cities such as São Paulo, Brasília and Rio de Janeiro.

Key Requirements :

- A bachelor’s degree in law or finance

- A high standard of written and spoken English and Portuguese are essential

- Excellent writing and interpersonal skills

- Outstanding attention to detail and a hard-working attitude

- Keen interest in law, finance and business

- Fluency in French is a bonus

Writer & Researcher (Full-Time) :

Salary : Competitive.

Hours : 40 hours per week.

Location : Pinheiros, São Paulo (Hybrid)

Starting Date : ASAP.

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch with you to let you know the next steps.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.

Estamos sempre analisando os currículos cadastrados e, havendo uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato para que você participe de nosso processo seletivo!



Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.


Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.



Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Região de Atuação: São Paulo e Região.

- Visita a clientes em Clinicas, Hospitais e Consultórios (públicos e privados), com o objetivo de identificar oportunidades de negócios.

- Orientar e acompanhar os profissionais da saúde na utilização e aplicação dos equipamentos e insumos da empresa - suporte e treinamento.


Pré-requisitos:

- Experiência no segmento de médico, preferencialmente em venda de consumíveis para cirurgias.
- Ter vivência na Oftalmologia será um grande diferencial.

- CNH em dia e disponibilidade para viagens e eventual trabalho aos finais de semana (participação em feiras e congressos, por exemplo).



Nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão

A ZEISS acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas em nossos processos seletivos. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de oportunidades. Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as diferenças.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Principal Software Engineer


Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Principal Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.


About John Deere & Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.


For 2025, John Deere is focused on advancing autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support its expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to manage the entire database infrastructure, focusing on SQL and Oracle Database. This team will drive innovation through Self-Service (enabling greater access and usability), Optimization (improving performance and efficiency), and Autonomous Operations (leveraging automation for scalability and reliability).


As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in transforming and innovating Distributed Database Platforms. Your work will align with John Deere's vision of delivering highly automated, AI-driven, and cloud-enabled data platforms, enhancing infrastructure solutions for better customer experiences. A key responsibility is maintaining quality and security by design, implementing best practices that uphold governance, security, and performance standards.


This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies such as data, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and cloud platforms to develop intuitive, self-healing, and optimized database solutions. You will collaborate across global teams, working across full technology stacks to solve enterprise-scale challenges, drive technology adoption, and influence change within a dynamic environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Backend Development - Design and implement scalable backend solutions for SQL and Oracle automation.
  • Database Platform Architecture - Define and build the foundation for a next-gen database platform.
  • API & AI Integration - Develop APIs and integrate AI-driven automation for enhanced performance.
  • Cloud & DevOps - Ensure cloud readiness using containers, microservices, and CI/CD.
  • Technology Integration - Work on seamless adoption of new technologies within existing systems.
  • Strategic Contribution - Help shape the team’s vision and long-term database automation strategy.
  • Autonomy & Proactivity - Take initiative, adapt to changes, and go beyond assigned tasks.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Design and build distributed database platforms to enhance the customer experience.
  • Define and drive innovative architectural solutions for platforms, customer interactions, and database products.
  • Align with the Product Pillars (Autonomous Operations and Optimization), ensuring effective integration into the platform.
  • Leverage AI to enhance systems and optimize processes as a Self-Service Product.
  • Shape the architecture and platform, including decisions around low-level configurations.
  • Ensure quality and security are integral to all processes and solutions.
  • Collaborate across teams to solve complex problems and implement cutting-edge technologies.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, C++, or Java, with experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with DBMS technologies, including SQLServer, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, with experience in containers and microservices.
  • Proven experience leveraging security and lean development principles such as CI/CD pipelines for scalability and continuous delivery.
  • Ability to understand and work with APIs, AI prompts, and data contexts to ensure seamless integration across systems.
  • Strong ability to integrate with existing technologies while defining new integration approaches.
  • Differential: Experience with full-stack design patterns, Machine Learning, AI, or GenAI using large language models.
  • Differential: Experience designing and building multi-cloud solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in an engineering field (e.G., Computer Engineering, Technology, etc.).
  • Advanced/Fluent English to report and collaborate in an international environment.


Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Hybrid role – 3x a week at the office.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Sobre a Online Garantias

A Online Garantias é uma empresa líder em soluções de garantias contratuais e judiciais, oferecendo serviços inovadores e ágeis para clientes de diversos segmentos. Nosso foco é conectar pessoas e empresas a soluções de garantias que tragam segurança financeira e eficiência nos processos, tudo de forma digital e prática.


Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Vendedor(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em vendas de produtos financeiros ou bancários. Conhecimento prévio no ramo de seguros ou garantias é um diferencial. A principal responsabilidade é prospectar novos clientes e estabelecer relacionamentos, com ênfase em contatos por telefone, reuniões virtuais e, ocasionalmente, visitas presenciais. Após criar o rapport com potenciais clientes, o(a) profissional irá repassar essas contas para a equipe interna de produtores comerciais que conduzirão as negociações seguintes.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e prospectar ativamente potenciais clientes por meio de ligações “frias”, redes de contato e outras estratégias de prospecção.
  • Realizar demonstrações e apresentações sobre os serviços de garantias, destacando benefícios e diferenciais competitivos.
  • Manter relacionamentos sólidos com prospects, criando confiança e construindo reputação de especialista em garantias financeiras.
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões (virtuais e/ou presenciais), bem como realizar follow-ups constantes até o momento de repassar o cliente para os produtores internos.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado em garantias e produtos financeiros, identificando oportunidades para alavancar as vendas.
  • Cumprir ou superar metas de vendas e indicadores de desempenho definidos pela empresa.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em vendas de produtos financeiros/bancários;
    conhecimento em segurosou garantias será considerado um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de construir rapport rapidamente por telefone e em reuniões presenciais.
  • Foco em resultados, organização e disciplina para gerenciar o pipeline de vendas.
  • Mentalidade voltada para prospecção ativa e abertura de novos negócios.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em São José dos Campos (SP) e para eventuais visitas externas.
  • Carisma e habilidade de se relacionar com pessoas de diferentes perfis, demonstrando empatia e confiança no contato inicial.
  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas correlatas (desejável).


O que Oferecemos

  • Salário compatível com o mercado e política de comissão atrativa.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com foco em crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa em franca expansão, com carteira de clientes diversificada.
  • Treinamentos e suporte interno para aprimorar conhecimentos sobre garantias e seguros.


---


About Online Garantias

Online Garantias is a leading company in contractual and judicial guarantee solutions, offering agile and innovative services to clients across various sectors. We focus on delivering efficient and digital financial security solutions, ensuring a streamlined and reliable experience for our customers.


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Sales Executive with proven experience in selling financial or banking products. Prior knowledge in insurance or guarantees is a plus. The main responsibility is to prospect new clients and build relationships, emphasizing phone outreach, virtual meetings, and occasional on-site visits. Once a strong rapport is established, the Senior Sales Executive will pass qualified clients on to the in-house sales producers who will continue negotiations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Actively identify and prospect potential clients through cold calls, networking, and other lead generation strategies.
  • Deliver presentations highlighting the benefits and competitive advantages of our guarantee solutions.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted expert in financial guarantees.
  • Organize and lead virtual or in-person meetings, performing regular follow-ups until handing over clients to internal producers.
  • Stay updated on market trends in guarantees and financial products to uncover opportunities and drive sales.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs set by the company.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Solid experience in sales of financial/banking products;
    knowledge of insurance or guarantees is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone and in person.
  • Results-driven mindset, strong organization, and discipline to manage a sales pipeline.
  • Proactive approach to prospecting and new business development.
  • Availability for on-site work in São José dos Campos (SP) and occasional external visits.
  • Charisma and ability to connect with diverse audiences, demonstrating empathy and confidence in initial contact.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or related fields (preferred).


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and attractive commission structure.
  • Collaborative work environment focused on growth and professional development.
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly expanding company with a diverse client portfolio.
  • Training and internal support to develop expertise in guarantees and insurance.


---


Se você se identifica com o perfil e acredita ter o carisma e a experiência para impulsionar nossas vendas, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte do time Online Garantias!

description:

title: Managing Director
description:
About Us

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.

We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.

We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services and as Contender in the Supply Chain IT Operation Services quadrant of the ISG Provider Lens™ Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories Logistics Consulting and TMS Provider .


Job descripiton:

The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Strategy

  • Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
  • Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
  • Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
  • Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.

Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects

  • Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
  • Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
  • Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
  • Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.


Qualifications and Competencies

Academic Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
  • Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.


Technical Skills (Supply Chain)

  • End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
  • Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.

title: Especialista Em Engenharia De Qualidade De Software

Escopo e Impacto

  1. Planejar e executar estratégias de testes funcionais e não funcionais , alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e diretrizes do COE;

  • Domínio de lógica de programação e bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, etc);

title: Especialista Em Produtos I - Seguro De Vida - Temporário
description:

Elaborar demandas para TI, validar documentação técnica e homologar sistemas relacionados aos produtos.

Criar e aplicar treinamentos sobre produtos e processos.

Estabelecer escopo e regras para desenvolvimento ou manutenção de produtos.


O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ


Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Atuariais, Estatística, Economia, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Vivência consolidada em seguros de vida.

Excelentes conhecimentos em pacote Office (incluindo Outlook) e ferramentas colaborativas (OneDrive, Teams).

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status;
    nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity;
    strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.Io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  1. Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.Pdf)
  2. Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  1. AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  2. Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

title: Iam Consultant Cybersecurity
description:
Korn Ferry has partnered with our client on their search for IAM Consultant Cybersecurity


The IAM Consultant Cybersecurity plays a critical role in strengthening an Asian financial institution in Brazil information security posture by ensuring that access to systems and data is granted appropriately, securely, and in full alignment with governance policies. This position exists to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets while enabling operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.


To expand its digital ecosystem, average of 300 modules and systems, where 20 systems with their modules will have SOD implemented through a risk matrix, the challenge lies in maintaining robust access controls across a complex and evolving environment. The IAM function is at the heart of this transformation, and this role is essential to bridge operational execution with strategic governance.


The professional in this role will be responsible not only for handling access requests but also for ensuring that each access is justified, traceable, and compliant with internal policies and external audit requirements. This includes working with tools like CyberArk , Varonis , and ServiceNow , while also supporting SoD validations and recertification processes.


The broader challenge for the Information Security team is to shift from a reactive access management model to a proactive, governance-driven approach, where risks are anticipated, processes are standardized, and security is embedded into every access decision. This position is key to driving that shift, bringing technical expertise, process discipline, and a strong sense of ownership to the IAM domain.

  • Be responsible for activities related to Identity, Privileged and Access management, and Segregation Duties through hands-on execution .

title: Senior Software Quality Analyst
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Software Quality Analyst , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of São Paulo.


In this role you will:

  1. Test Planning and Design:

- Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements.

- Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and acceptance criteria.

2. Test Execution:

- Execute manual and automated tests to identify software defects and ensure that applications meet quality standards.

- Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, performance, and usability testing.

3. Defect Management:

- Identify, document, and track software defects using bug tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or Azure Devops.

- Work closely with the development team to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve defects.

4. Automation Testing:

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, or similar frameworks.

- Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing and rapid feedback.

5. Test Environment Management:

- Set up and maintain test environments, including test data and configurations.

- Ensure that test environments are representative of production environments to accurately assess application performance and behavior.

6. Reporting and Documentation:

- Prepare and present test reports, including test coverage, test results, and defect metrics.

- Document test procedures, test cases, and test results for future reference and audit purposes.

7. Continuous Improvement:

- Participate in retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

- Stay current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and quality assurance.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance.

- Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.

- Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, or similar.

- Proficiency in using bug tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or Trello.

- Knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills.

description:
Datacenter People is a specialized recruitment company working with the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world.

  • Act as project coordinator with other field engineers, coordinating printing, presentation and administration procedures.
  • Review shop drawings and submittals.


The Experience Profile

  • Experience of commissioning mechanical systems in a data center or large commercial/industrial setting – typically 500kVA or above. OR Experience in a senior commissioning role with the ability to interpret the same, in lieu of this a technical background.
  • Ability to determine and interpret data from various sources such as external PQM waveforms, data logs etc.
  • Ability to determine pass/fail criteria.
  • Conversant in data center topologies across varied designs: N+1, N+2, 2N etc.
  • Fault finding/trouble-shooting knowledge of various integrated systems such as HVAC systems, Refrigeration, Air Handling Units, Chiller systems, Cooling units
  • Working knowledge of network and communications – Modbus/ethernet, SCADA systems etc.
  • Understanding of data center commissioning levels and the requirements to move from level-to-level.
  • Knowledge of scheduling/planning/reporting.

About the job

Position Summary:


Responsible for the overall project planning, business process analysis, coordination, tendering, implementation, execution, control, and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals, and a highly efficient development / deployment process.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Facilitate the definition of project objectives, use case building, project scope, resource identification and team setup, project tendering, scheduling of project timeline and design of detailed project tasks
  • Apply Americas PPG IT Project Management methodology to identify the clear end to end process from project inception, pilot, pilot review and go live decision making to roll out, result tracking and post-implementation review.
  • Develop project plan/task list using an appropriate planning tool and standard methodologies.
  • Work closely with project business owners and representatives to analyze and document business processes and requirements, drive problem-solving processes, and propose solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional project team/key stakeholders to plan, pilot, implement and track each project and initiative and ensure its qualitative and quantitative success towards the business objectives, and value adding for the functions.
  • Coordinate between all stakeholders to ensure that implementation of the new systems is done in a timely manner, delivered in quality, and meeting the business requirements.
  • Coordinate with related business functions both locally, regionally, and globally for alignment and drive implementation.
  • Responsible for the validation and prioritization of requirements and demands, and project management of the initiatives.
  • Track project deliverables and report on progress of the project-to-project lead using appropriate tools.
  • Prepare business analysis and summary documents to support the project evaluations and assessment of results .
  • Manage task to completion ensuring successful delivery.
  • Manage changes to project scope, costs, time, resources as part of change management and provide visibility to management on the project's progress.
  • Estimate potential risk and mitigate from time to time to reduce its negative impact on the project.
  • Captures a list of project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies for their project.
  • Serves as the point of contact between the business stakeholders and the technical team in making sure the requirements are clearly understood and translated to the functional requirements by leveraging on the resources and skill set within and across the work-streams.
  • Lead and supervise project team members and vendors in accomplishing assigned tasks.


Qualifications & Experience:


The ideal candidate for this position is curious about how to drive maximum business value through the IT project management function. They will have a laser focus for being on time and on budget with quality deliverables. The candidate will need to be:


  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • A strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable interacting with colleagues at all levels
  • Able to effectively multi-task and deliver quality results within fast-paced project deliverable deadlines.
  • Capability of holistic thinking, being able to connect dots.
  • Experience in conducting business process analysis, capturing, and documenting business requirements.
  • Good at building networks, connections, positive collaborations, and consensus.
  • Flexible and resilient, ready to face new approaches.
  • Able to work & make decisions independently, as well as part of a team.
  • Able to clearly describe and isolate in-scope and out-of-scope elements.
  • Able to interact with multiple stakeholders at different levels within the organization.

REQUISITOS

  • 3+ anos de experiência em performance, growth ou marketing digital orientado a dados.

  • Experiência em gestão de squad ou liderança de pequeno time.

  • Experiência em lançamentos digitais para B2C
  • Experiência em marketing de guerrilha até a construção estabilizada da performance e resultado esperado
  • Perfil hands-on com mentalidade de fundador: cria, testa e mede com velocidade sem perder a mão da priorização e timing de execução
  • Idioma inglês é bem vindo


SOFT SKILLS

  • Capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo (Walk the Talk).
  • Curiosidade técnica e espírito hacker com ética profissional.
  • Comunicação clara e integradora entre marketing e vendas.

title: Estágio Em Importação
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Estagiário em Custos, você irá:

title: High School Principal
description:
Position: High School Principal

Application Deadline: October 20th, 2025

Start Date: July, 2026


Main responsibilities: Lead the daily operations of the High School, ensuring efficient, safe, and student-centered management. Build and mentor teacher leaders through regular feedback, coaching, and professional development. Collaborate with academic leadership to ensure high standards of teaching and learning across Grades 9–12, aligned with IB and national requirements. Oversee academic, co-curricular, and student support programs that respond to student needs and promote holistic growth. Foster a positive, professional, and inclusive school culture that upholds ethical and academic excellence.

Partner with the IB Diploma Coordinator to ensure the effective implementation and integrity of the IB Diploma Programme. Work with the College Counselor to support students in their preparation for university admissions, both local and international.


Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Educational Leadership, School Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3–5 years of leadership experience in a High School setting preferred.

Demonstrated experience with the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IB DP). Principal certification, licensure, or equivalent administrative credential (or eligibility to obtain). Excellent communication skills in English, suited to an international bilingual community. Strong record of instructional leadership, teacher development, and data-informed decision-making. Cross-cultural sensitivity and experience working in international or IB-authorized schools. Familiarity with the Brazilian educational context and proficiency in Portuguese are preferred.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities;
learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth;
they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.


Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.Js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.Js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen;
    every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

    investment in professional development.

FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS


Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.

description:

QA & RA Specialist (100 % workload)


About Selectchemie AG

Selectchemie is an independent Swiss company serving the pharmaceutical and nutrition industry since 1969 as a premier supplier of high quality ingredients and generic finished dosage forms. As a full service provider we create added value by offering comprehensive technical, scientific, regulatory and commercial support all along the value chain. Worldwide, our 120 experienced professionals with commercial and scientific background, based at the headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland and locations in 18 countries, provide customers, principals and suppliers with solutions tailored to their needs.


Join our Pharma LATAM team

We offer a broad product portfolio of APIs & excipients and are an established hub for customers sourcing high-quality bulk raw material as well as for renowned manufacturers who benefit from our broad customer base in various markets. We are continuously expanding our global network as well as our services. We are seeking a QA & RA Associate to support our Pharma LATAM sales team in achieving their regulatory and quality assurance objectives, with focus on Brazilian and Mexican markets. This role involves close collaboration with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure compliance with ANVISA and other relevant regulations. The ideal candidate will have a strong regulatory mindset, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills.


Your tasks and responsibilities


ANVISA Submissions & API/Excipients Registration

  • Prepare, submit, and manage ANVISA dossiers from our partners and of our ownership for API and excipient registrations, renewals, variations, and amendments, in accordance with RDC 359/2022 and RDC 361/2022, which require registration of APIs used in distribution and manufacturing in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with ANVISA regulatory guidelines, monitor updates to regulatory frameworks, and implement required modifications proactively.
  • Be designated as an authorized user in order to act on behalf of the suppliers for CADIFA application.


Life Cycle Management (LCM)

  • Carry out lifecycle maintenance activities, including annual renewals, post-approval changes, and variations for APIs registrations – CADIFA under established procedures
  • Conduct gap analysis for regulatory documents and gather necessary supporting documentation from suppliers and internal stakeholders.


Regulatory Intelligence & Compliance

  • Monitor evolving Brazilian regulatory requirements and advise stakeholders accordingly.
  • Support internal teams—such as Quality, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial—by providing up-to-date regulatory guidance for API/excipient registration, import, storage, and distribution compliance.


Client & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide regulatory support and guidance to internal clients (e.G., sales, procurement) and external clients (e.G., manufacturers or exporters of APIs/excipients) regarding registration strategy, timelines, and documentation requirements.
  • Assist during ANVISA inspections, inquiries, or audits, and support resolution of any regulatory issues by preparing requested documentation and supporting senior colleagues.


Documentation & Submission Management

  • Assemble submission packages with precision—compiling documentation, certificates (e.G., GMP, certificates of analysis), product specifications, technical data, and translations where necessary.
  • Maintain regulatory dossier documentation in tracked systems to ensure completeness and ease of retrieval.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with commercial, quality assurance, procurement, and legal teams to align on regulatory deliverables and prioritize registration activities.
  • Share documentation with regional/global RA teams for alignment.


Process Enhancement & SOP Development

  • Follow existing SOPs related to APIs/excipients registration, dossier submission, product renewal, and regulatory intelligence and provide feedback on potential improvements
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to optimize submission workflows and compliance robustness.


Training & Regulatory Advocacy

  • Educate relevant internal teams (e.G. sales, imports) on regulatory implications—for example, registration deadlines, documentation requirements, handling of restricted substances—to ensure regulatory awareness throughout the organization.
  • When relevant, participate in trade associations or regulatory working groups to stay informed and potentially influence ANVISA’s regulatory environment.


Your profile

  • Education: Degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance, preferably in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of ANVISA regulations, GMP, and regulatory processes.
  • Skills: Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Communication: Ability to effectively interact with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Spanish is a plus.


What’s in for you?

  • Entrepreneurial position in a dynamic globally acting team
  • Your input is key and you’re part of creating our future success
  • Close cooperation with colleagues across the entire hierarchy within Selectchemie
  • Short decision processes
  • Attractive compensation package and hybrid working

title: Analista Sênior De Segurança De Aplicações
description:
Sobre a Edenred:

A Edenred é a plataforma digital líder para serviços e meios de pagamento, que atua como a companhia diária para pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 60 milhões de usuários e mais de 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros, em 45 países, por meio de aproximadamente 1 milhão de empresas-clientes.

No Brasil, sua atuação conta com três linhas de negócios: Benefícios e Engajamento, com a marca Ticket;
Mobilidade, com as marcas Edenred Ticket Log e Edenred Repom;
e Soluções de Pagamentoe Novos Mercados, com Edenred Pay e Punto.

Em 2024, graças aos seus ativos tecnológicos globais, o Grupo gerenciou cerca de €45 bilhões em volume de negócios, realizados principalmente por meio de aplicativos móveis, plataformas online e cartões.

A Edenred é listada na bolsa de valores Euronext Paris e está incluída nos seguintes índices: CAC 40, CAC 40 ESG, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index e MSCI Europe.


Sobre a posição:

Você fará parte do time de Cyber Security da Edenred, dedicado à proteção das aplicações do grupo. Esta vaga tem foco em segurança ofensiva : seu principal desafio será planejar, executar e reportar pentests , testes de intrusão internos e análises de vulnerabilidades, identificando riscos reais e propondo melhorias práticas.

Além disso, você será referência na promoção de princípios de segurança e privacidade, ajudando a disseminar padrões do grupo, apoiar projetos estratégicos e fortalecer a cultura de codificação segura. Atuará em colaboração com times de desenvolvimento e arquitetura, participando de iniciativas de mitigação de incidentes e contribuindo para a evolução contínua da segurança em toda a organização.

No seu dia-dia você terá interação com pessoas de vários países e oportunidade de falar inglês com frequência.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Garantir Security by Design, Segurança de Rede e práticas de Codificação Segura em projetos.
  • Integrar, manter e gerenciar ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades, scanners e políticas de firewall de aplicações.
  • Realizar testes internos de intrusão e apresentar evidências aos stakeholders quando necessário.
  • Participar ativamente do agendamento e encerramento de testes de penetração realizados por terceiros.
  • Administrar, reportar, aconselhar e acompanhar planos de ação de vulnerabilidades (mitigação e remediação) com stakeholders das unidades de negócio e times de desenvolvimento.
  • Fornecer orientação sobre Segurança de Redes conforme padrões corporativos.
  • Manter e controlar o perímetro de aplicações regionais.
  • Apoiar o Centro de Excelência em Segurança de Aplicações (matriz).
  • Participar da resposta a incidentes (detecção, controle, resposta e reporte).
  • Garantir controle de qualidade e lições aprendidas nas ações de segurança em todas as camadas.
  • Governar e gerenciar procedimentos, diretrizes, diagramas e baselines relacionados à segurança.
  • Gerenciar Cartas de Aceite de Risco, assegurando correta responsabilização e escalonamento.
  • Contribuir para a construção do Book mensal de KPIs, RCA e SLA da área.
  • Promover treinamentos e workshops mensais de melhores práticas de segurança para times técnicos no Brasil, além de sessões de conscientização.


Requisitos necessários para essa vaga:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos atuando com pentest, testes de intrusão e análise de vulnerabilidades em aplicações.
  • Vivência em Segurança em Projetos: Desenvolvimento Seguro (Agile e cascata), Arquitetura Segura e Privacidade de Dados.
  • Vivência na execução e controle de varreduras de vulnerabilidades, DAST (Web Scanning), SAST (ferramentas de revisão de código) e testes internos de intrusão.
  • Sólido conhecimento nos processos de CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery).
  • Conhecimento em práticas e metodologia de riscos OWASP Top 10.


Competências que buscamos:

  • Facilidade para dialogar e construir soluções junto a times técnicos.
  • Time sem espaço para ego: colaboração é nosso protocolo padrão.
  • Comunicação clara e aberta, inclusive para apoiar programas de conscientização em segurança.
  • Inglês para conversação é essencial já que você trabalhará com pessoas da França e outros países diariamente.


Pontos diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integrações de pipelines em nuvem;
  • Experiência em análise de logs de WAF;
  • Conhecimento emlinguagens de programação como: C#, VB .NET, Perl, PHP, Java ou Python;
  • Certificação Ethical Hacking (EH).
  • Certificação CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional) ou similar.


Benefícios que oferecemos:

Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido em Pinheiros (2x por semana);

Ticket Restaurante + Ticket Alimentação;

Quem somos nós


A Keeta é a subsidiária internacional da Meituan, gigante global no setor de entregas, e está em uma missão ambiciosa: revolucionar a entrega de alimentos e produtos de consumo em todo o mundo. Nosso lema é simples e poderoso: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, viver melhor.” É com base nele que levamos inovação e tecnologia para o cenário global.

Com mais de 1.000 colaboradores no mundo, a Keeta está em plena expansão — e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada!


Suas responsabilidades

  • Atuar como um parceiro estratégico de RH, apoiando os esforços de aquisição de talentos e construindo mecanismos de longo prazo para o desenvolvimento e retenção de colaboradores.
  • Servir como elo entre as áreas de negócio e o RH, garantindo sintonia e colaboração para o alcance dos resultados organizacionais.
  • Prestar consultoria interna a líderes e equipes, oferecendo soluções ágeis, simplificadas e adaptadas às demandas locais.
  • Conduzir e supervisionar todo o ciclo de vida do colaborador, desde a entrada até o desligamento, promovendo experiências consistentes e positivas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de Talent Acquisition para alinhar estratégias de atração e seleção de acordo com as prioridades do negócio.
  • Monitorar e apoiar a gestão de desempenho e do clima organizacional, fornecendo análises e dados que fortaleçam a tomada de decisão dos líderes.
  • Identificar necessidades de desenvolvimento, apoiando líderes na criação e execução de projetos e iniciativas de treinamento.
  • Garantir a conformidade com políticas internas, legislações locais e práticas de diversidade e inclusão.
  • Aplicar visão de negócios para propor melhorias de estrutura organizacional e eficiência operacional.
  • Liderar iniciativas culturais que aumentem o engajamento, a coesão das equipes e a construção de um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo.
  • Atuar como ponte cultural e estratégica entre equipes locais e a liderança global, trazendo percepções críticas que apoiem o crescimento sustentável.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa;
    mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em cargos de Recursos Humanos.
  • Experiência prévia de no mínimo 5 anos como HRBP em empresas de internet/tecnologia é altamente desejável.
  • Fluência em inglês é obrigatória.
  • Capacidade de analisar organizações, propor estruturas eficazes e liderar iniciativas de RH em cenários dinâmicos e de alta velocidade.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade, acessibilidade e habilidade de construir relações de confiança em todos os níveis.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.
  • Por favor nos envie o cv em inglês.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas na fase inicial de operação no Brasil (stage 0→1), especialmente em contextos de rápida expansão.
  • Vivência com empresas chinesas ou em ambientes multiculturais com estruturas e dinâmicas asiáticas.

Interessado(a) em fazer parte da Keeta?


Confira nossas vagas abertas! Ao se candidatar, suas informações serão armazenadas de forma segura e poderão ser compartilhadas com a Keeta e suas empresas afiliadas ao redor do mundo.
